Priya: Quick heads-up: emergency push tonight in VPC window at 23:15 UTC. Target image: private-installer:2.10.1-hotpatch. Fixes a systemd race causing services to fail on first boot. Need packaging + ops ack.
Noah: Ack. Building delta + full bundle. Will upload signed manifest.
deploybot: packaging job #2910 queued. artifacts: bundle-2.10.1-hotpatch.tar.gz, delta-2.10.0->2.10.1.patch.
Priya: Canary: 2 seeds (pvstg-a, pvstg-b), then mirror smoke to mirror-int-1. 15m watch.
Noah: Cosign pipeline green locally, but mirror signing sometimes lags. If cosign missing, do NOT pin to customer mirrors.
Priya: Rollback criteria: immediate rollback if installer exits non-zero on any seed twice OR >8% failures on mirror smoke. Rollforward (retry) allowed for transient network errors under 8%.
deploybot: canary started @23:15:45 on [pvstg-a,pvstg-b].
Noah: pvstg-a delta applied OK. pvstg-b failed with transient tar read timeout, retrying.
Priya: If pvstg-b fails again, switch to full bundle for that seed.
deploybot: pvstg-b retry OK @23:17:12. Canary 2/2 green.
Noah: Uploading signed manifest to s3://private-releases/hotpatch/2.10.1/manifest.json.sig
Priya: Proceed to mirror-int-1. Remember change window ends 00:00 UTC. If signer TTL <7 days, abort.
deploybot: mirror-int-1 applied; manifest cosign verified. mirror smoke: 1.5% transient network errors auto-retried.
Priya: Good. Pin command ready: `./releasectl pin --env=private --image=private-installer:2.10.1-hotpatch --manifest=man-2.10.1.json`
Noah: Tagging: `git tag release/private-2.10.1-hotpatch && git push origin --tags`
oncall: I'll watch alerts. Ping if >8% failures or cosign mismatch.
